note: THE SPINE. What is true about January EVERY year: the annual fixtures as date RULES, and the character of the month. Everything true in one year only lives in january-<year>.json. Same shape as the December spine so scripts/check-month-freshness.mjs reads both the same way.
rules: A fixture belongs here only if it recurs annually AND is run by a body with a website. Dates come from the organiser, never a listings site. Every entry carries `official` and `verified`. If a fixture is missed in a year, do not delete it: set `status` and say why. Anything a listings site or a language model will confidently place in January that is actually elsewhere, or in another month, goes in `notInJanuary` with the proof.

character.inOneLine: The coldest month by daily high, with the Christmas machinery switched off after the first weekend, then art, snooker, theatre openings and the first sales of the year.
character.weather: Met Office Heathrow monthly records, 1991 to 2020 averages (computed from the Met Office's station data file): a daily high of 8.4C, a daily low of 2.7C, 58.8mm of rain, 59.0 hours of sunshine and 6.8 air-frost days. January has the lowest daily high of any month; December has more air frost (7.2 days) and less sunshine (53 hours).
character.daylight: Sunset in central London (51.5074N, 0.1278W, GMT all month) is 4.01pm on 1 January, 4.12pm on the 10th, 4.20pm on the 15th and 4.47pm on the 31st. Sunrise moves from 8.05am on the 1st to 7.40am on the 31st. Day length grows from 7 hours 56 minutes to 9 hours 7 minutes. Source: api.sunrise-sunset.org for the central London coordinates, UTC equals GMT all month.
character.crowds: The first weekend is the last of the Christmas crowds. Schools in England are back around 4 January and January has no half term; 1 January is the only bank holiday. Weekdays after the first weekend are the quietest of the year at most attractions.
character.seasonShape: Four beats: New Year's Day (the Parade, closures, rail engineering), the Christmas wind-down (Winter Wonderland, Kew, rinks and markets close from 3 to 10 January), the sports and theatre run (darts final, Masters snooker, West End openings, the New Year Sale) and the art and festival fortnight in the second half (MimeLondon, London Art Fair).

standingSections.note: Slots that recur every year. Source each from the operator, not a listings site.

theatreOpeningsAndClosings.sourceFrom: The theatre's or producer's own what's-on page, or Official London Theatre's show pages. The Christmas Nutcrackers, pantos and Bourne's Christmas show end between 3 and 17 January.

exhibitionsOpeningAndClosing.sourceFrom: The museum's own what's-on page. Most big autumn exhibitions close on 31 January or earlier; few open in January.

sportAndAlexandraPalace.sourceFrom: Alexandra Palace's own what's-on pages (darts final, Masters snooker); the FA's round-dates page; the Premier League's fixtures feed for London home games.

fixtures.name: London New Year's Day Parade
fixtures.what: A parade of marching bands, dancers, cheerleaders and floats from Piccadilly to Whitehall, free to watch standing, with ticketed grandstand and VIP seating.
fixtures.dateRule: 1 January every year. 2027: Friday 1 January, 1pm to 4.30pm.
fixtures.area: Piccadilly, Regent Street, St James's, Pall Mall, Trafalgar Square and Whitehall
fixtures.price: Free standing; grandstand, VIP and Fun Zone tickets sold through Ticketmaster.
fixtures.booking: Seats through Ticketmaster; none needed to stand.

fixtures.name: The end of the Christmas season
fixtures.what: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland, Christmas at Kew, the Hampton Court rink and most chalet markets close on the first weekend of January; Somerset House's rink runs about a week longer.
fixtures.dateRule: First Sunday of January for most; Somerset House about the second Sunday. 2027: 3 January (Winter Wonderland, Kew, Hampton Court, Battersea Power Station), 4 January (Alexandra Palace Festive Skate), 10 January (Somerset House).
fixtures.area: Hyde Park, Kew, Hampton Court, Battersea, Alexandra Palace, Somerset House

fixtures.name: PDC World Darts Championship, to the final
fixtures.what: The world title tournament at Alexandra Palace, ending in the first days of January.
fixtures.dateRule: Mid-December to 3 January. 2026-27: 11 December 2026 to 3 January 2027, Great Hall.
fixtures.booking: Ballot closed; resale only via the organiser's official platform.

fixtures.name: Masters snooker
fixtures.what: Invitation tournament for the world's top 16 players, held at Alexandra Palace since 2012.
fixtures.dateRule: Mid-January, a Sunday to Sunday. 2027: 10 to 17 January, West Hall, doors 11.30am.
fixtures.typical: Second to third week of January

fixtures.name: London Art Fair
fixtures.what: Modern and contemporary galleries selling direct, at the Business Design Centre in Islington.
fixtures.dateRule: Third week of January. 2027: preview Tuesday 19 January, public Wednesday 20 to Sunday 24 January (the 39th edition).
fixtures.price: Day ticket £27.75 in advance including a £4.25 fee, £28 on the door; preview evening £42.75 advance; Wednesday Late £21.25; Premier Pass £50.25.

fixtures.name: MimeLondon
fixtures.what: A season of visual and physical theatre curated with the Barbican, Sadler's Wells, Southbank Centre and The Place. It continues the London International Mime Festival (1977 to 2023).
fixtures.dateRule: Mid-January to early February. 2027: supported events 9 January to 6 February.
fixtures.area: Barbican, Southbank Centre, Sadler's Wells East, The Place
fixtures.booking: Each venue's box office, linked from mimelondon.com.

fixtures.name: Official London Theatre New Year Sale
fixtures.what: Society of London Theatre's winter discount campaign (earlier branded Get Into London Theatre).
fixtures.dateRule: Launches early January. 2027: 5 January; end date and terms not yet published.

fixtures.name: FA Cup third round proper
fixtures.what: Premier League and Championship clubs enter the FA Cup.
fixtures.dateRule: A Saturday in the first half of January. 2027: Saturday 9 January.
fixtures.booking: Clubs' own sites after the draw.

fixtures.name: Premier League London home games
fixtures.what: Home games of Arsenal, Brentford, Chelsea, Crystal Palace, Fulham and Spurs.
fixtures.dateRule: Fixtures are set each summer; the League's listed kick-offs move when broadcasters pick games.
fixtures.verifiedNote: Read from the League's own fixtures feed on 4 November 2026.

notInJanuary.name: Chinese New Year in London
notInJanuary.theError: Listings sites place Chinatown's celebration in January.
notInJanuary.theTruth: Lunar New Year 2027 falls on Saturday 6 February; the celebration is in February.
notInJanuary.verifiedNote: Royal Museums Greenwich lists its own Lunar New Year day on Saturday 13 February 2027.

notInJanuary.name: London International Mime Festival
notInJanuary.theError: Still listed as an annual January festival by older pages.
notInJanuary.theTruth: It ended with its 47th edition in 2023; MimeLondon is the successor.

notInJanuary.name: Kids Week
notInJanuary.theError: Often listed as a January family event.
notInJanuary.theTruth: It runs through the summer holidays; the 2026 edition is over and 2027 is announced only as 'back before you know it'.

notInJanuary.name: Get Into London Theatre
notInJanuary.theError: The old brand for the January deals.
notInJanuary.theTruth: The campaign now runs as Official London Theatre's New Year Sale, launching 5 January 2027.
